title: Daily PM plan leads the short heartbeat
query: Weekly strategy is fresh, several tickets are open, and the short PM heartbeat is enabled. What should the daily PM plan produce?
reference_points: Reads weekly strategy, recent heartbeat outcomes, tickets, goals, and ledger
Produces ranked daily action lanes rather than executing broad work
Names blockers, stale tickets, and human-gated work separately
Writes a daily plan report for pm-heartbeat to consume
Decides whether ticket execution belongs to daily drainer or short heartbeat based on policy

title: Daily PM plan uses feed scout by freshness
query: The daily planner needs external signals, but yesterday's external context report is still fresh enough. Should it run full feed scout?
reference_points: Reuses fresh external context when within freshness policy
Does not run full feed scout by default just because a daily plan is running
Requests lightweight or full scouting only when stale or required by the decision
Keeps the daily output focused on today's priorities
Records source freshness or gap in the report
